name: Password
whenToUse: Signing in, setting or changing a password — with show/hide.

whenNotToUse.text: API keys and tokens shown to the person

anatomy.description: a TextField with the show/hide toggle in its right slot.
the rule, shown before typing (“At least 8 characters.”).
PasswordStrengthMeter under it, for new passwords.

do.caption: The rule is visible before the first attempt.
do.example: <Password label="New password" description="At least 8 characters." widthSize="lg" />

dont.caption: The rule only appears as an error, after failing.
dont.example: <Password label="New password" error="Password is too weak." widthSize="lg" />

do.caption: One field; show/hide lets people check what they typed.

dont.caption: A “repeat” field doubles the typing and still doesn’t catch a typo made twice.

a11y: `autoComplete="current-password"` to sign in, `"new-password"` to set one — password managers depend on it.
The toggle is a button with a name that says what it will do (“Show password”).

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text below the field. Hidden when `error` or `success` is set.

props.name: error
props.description:
Error message shown below the field with a warning icon, and
switches the field to its error styling. Pass `true` for error
styling with no message, or a string/node for styling + message.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: 'top' (default) stacks label above the field. 'left' puts a fixed 216px label column beside it, matching Figma's horizontal Formfield layout.

props.name: optional
props.description: Shows "(optional)" after the label. Ignored when `required`.

props.name: required
props.description: Shows a small red asterisk after the label.

props.name: success
props.description:
Success message shown below the field with a check icon, and
switches the field to its success styling. Pass `true` for success
styling with no message, or a string/node for styling + message.
Ignored when `error` is set.
